2nd XV Players.description: Each row represents a match played by the 2nd XV squad, including general match information, player names, lineout and scrum stats. This data is recorded from 2021 onwards. Previously, Pitchero is the source for match results and player names.

C.description: Name of the opposing team (club name with 'II' or 'III' appended for 2nd or 3rd teams)

D.description: Type of score (Try, Conversion, Penalty, or Drop Goal)

E.description: Number of times the player scored

F.description: Name of the player who scored

G.description: Number of points scored by the player (Try=5, Con=2, Pen=3, DG=3)

Scorers.description: Each row represents a type of score by a player in a match. Only recorded from 2025/26 season onwards. Previously, Pitchero is the source for scoring data.

A.description: Lineout number in the match (1 for the first lineout, 2 for the second, etc.)

E.description: Name of the opposing team (club name with 'II' or 'III' appended for 2nd or 3rd teams)

G.description: Call made for the lineout (can be empty for no call, or a string, or a number, or '*' for a quick throw)

H.description: Dummy jump in the lineout ('x' if there was a dummy, otherwise empty)

I.description: Thrown to the front ('x' if thrown to the front, otherwise empty)

J.description: Thrown to the middle ('x' if thrown to the middle, otherwise empty)

K.description: Thrown to the back ('x' if thrown to the back, otherwise empty)

L.description: Ball brought down for a maul/drive ('x' if there was a drive, otherwise empty)

M.description: Crusaders call ('x' if there was a Crusaders call, otherwise empty)

N.description: Transfer of the ball between jumpers ('x' if there was a transfer, otherwise empty)

O.description: Flyby call ('x' if there was a flyby call, otherwise empty)

R.description: Whether the lineout was won (Y) or lost (N)

S.description: Additional notes about the lineout, mostly a reason for lost lineouts (e.g. 'stolen', 'overthrow')

Lineouts.description: Each row represents a lineout in a match.

E.description: Rank of the team in the league

F.description: Number of teams in the league

League History.description: Each row represents a season of a league in which an East Grinstead squad participated, including the league name, level, and the team's final rank. This data is recorded from the 2003/04 season onwards.

C.description: Name of the award (e.g. 'Player of the Season', 'Players' Player of the Season')

Awards.description: Each row represents an end-of-season award given to a player, including the season, squad, award name, and recipient. This data is recorded from the 2018/19 season onwards.
